notes: Mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B product analytics). Started on Redwood Hosted API to validate embeddings + reranking for in-product search and a support assistant. Hosted POC showed good accuracy but projected cost at scale pushed the account to request Dedicated pricing and a VPC deployment. Primary drivers: predictable latency, cost per embedding, and strict security/compliance (SOC2 + SSO/SAML + audit log retention). Current ask: Dedicated (VPC) quote + evidence for SOC2 controls and an architecture doc for network/VPC peering. Technical constraints: p95 generation latency target <= 250ms for user-facing search at 100–150 qps (batched); offline embedding pipeline tolerates higher latency. Must support SAML SSO (Okta), SCIM for user provisioning, and provide audit log export (syslog/ELK/S3) with configurable retention windows (90/365/forever). Customer security team also asked about KMS/HSM integration for model request encryption keys and proof of no-data-retention on Redwood side for PII. Legal expects SOC2 Type II report or in-progress evidence by end of procurement cycle. AE note: price sensitivity—aim to position Dedicated with committed throughput tiers to meet ARR target.
